summary: Verified frontend login fix. Login with diego.haidmann@gmail.com / Admin@2026 via /login succeeds and redirects to /dashboard. Requests go to the correct preview host (b232168a-...) and NOT the old quick-deploy-341 host. Dashboard shows real seeded data (Capital R$102.241,00; 37 Clientes Ativos; 37 Empréstimos Ativos). Clientes page renders 37+ rows.

issues: 'Empréstimos' is an expandable menu item — clicking the label doesn't navigate to a list route; it stayed on /clientes. Consider making top-level click open a default sublink.

critical_code_review_comments: public/env-config.js overriding REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is fragile — a stale value silently breaks the whole app. Recommend deriving window._env_ from build-time env or removing env-config.js entirely and relying on process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login and preview host routing validated. Data from restored backup visible (37 clientes, 37 empréstimos ativos, R$102k capital). If env-config.js gets stale again the app will silently point to a wrong backend — check that file first if login fails.
